summary: Custom tests go in a test_plugins directory next to the play, inside a role or in a configured test plugin path.
questions: Where do I put a custom test plugin?
Can a role ship its own Jinja tests?

answer_card.title: Adding a custom test plugin
answer_card.answer_md: Place it in a `test_plugins` directory next to your play, inside a role, or in a configured test plugin directory.
